parsedVerdict.reasoning: Coverage.ts sits in the domain layer, but it is set up as a TypeORM persistence entity. The class carries the decorator @Entity() and the property peril carries @Column(). Both are ORM mapping metadata, which tells the framework how to store the class in the database. That is a persistence concern and belongs in the infrastructure layer. The rest of the file (fields and constructor) is a plain domain value holder. The persistence mapping is still a misplaced responsibility, and judging it does not depend on the import-direction rule.
